title: Matte White Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet, 49-Inch Solid Brass Towel Stand, Traditional, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Matte White, freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet for bathroom towel storage and towel drying, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. Floor standing towel stand / freestanding towel rack / towel holder with four pivoting swing arms to maximize space and separate towels. Dimensions: 49 inches high (49-inch, 49in) x 12 inches long (12-inch, 12in) x 10.5 inches wide (10.5-inch, 10.5in). Crafted from solid brass (brass construction) for corrosion-free and rust-free performance with a lifetime designer finish. Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching on any surface. Traditional style for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Includes towel stand. Some assembly required. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
